entries: **Statusline progress bar visual refresh**: progress bar characters switched from `█░` to `■□` (filled / hollow squares), and the color palette moved from standard ANSI green/yellow/red (32/33/31) to 256-color teal/orange/dark-red (42/214/160) for stronger contrast around the 50% threshold — safe / warning / danger states are now distinguishable at a glance. Changes confined to `usage_statusline.py` (`progress_bar()` and `color_by_pct()`); HTML reports and the TUI progress bars are unaffected.
**Traditional Chinese default panel screenshot refreshed**: `docs/繁體中文面板.png` updated to reflect the latest UI (new "Report / Terminal" toggle, per-project cost display, footer attribution).

title.zh-TW: 狀態列進度條換上新裝，一眼看懂額度緊不緊
title.en: Statusline progress bar gets a visual refresh for at-a-glance readability

body.zh-TW: 終端機狀態列上的進度條現在變得更醒目了。以前的進度條是用普通的 ANSI 綠、黃、紅，現在換成了對比更強的 256 色青綠、暖橘和暗紅，而且格子符號也換成了更清晰的「■□」（實心／空心方塊）。現在你只要瞄一眼，就能立刻分辨目前的額度用量是處於安全、警告還是危險狀態。這就像是把原本黯淡的紅綠燈換成了高亮度的 LED 號誌，大老遠就能看清要不要踩煞車。另外，我們也順便把說明文件裡的繁體中文面板截圖換成了包含近期介面改動的最新版本。
body.en: The progress bar on the terminal statusline is now much easier to read. We've switched the characters to clearer solid and hollow squares ("■□"), and moved from standard ANSI colors to a high-contrast 256-color palette (teal, orange, and dark red). Now, you can instantly tell if your usage is in a safe, warning, or danger state with just a quick glance. It's like upgrading a dim traffic light to ultra-bright LEDs—you know exactly when to hit the brakes from a mile away. We've also updated the Traditional Chinese panel screenshot in the documentation to reflect the latest UI changes.

items.original:
**Statusline progress bar visual refresh**: progress bar characters switched from `█░` to `■□` (filled / hollow squares), and the color palette moved from standard ANSI green/yellow/red (32/33/31) to 256-color teal/orange/dark-red (42/214/160) for stronger contrast around the 50% threshold — safe / warning / danger states are now distinguishable at a glance. Changes confined to `usage_statusline.py` (`progress_bar()` and `color_by_pct()`); HTML reports and the TUI progress bars are unaffected.
**Traditional Chinese default panel screenshot refreshed**: `docs/繁體中文面板.png` updated to reflect the latest UI (new "Report / Terminal" toggle, per-project cost display, footer attribution).

entries: **Codex usage panel no longer falls back to `--` after a burst of short sessions**: `codex_loader.load_rate_limits()` only scanned the 5 most recent jsonl files via `_recent_jsonl_files()` to find rate_limits. Codex CLI (observed on 0.134.0) writes `payload.rate_limits == null` for short or interrupted sessions (a quick `codex exec` run, Ctrl-C, etc.); when the latest 5 sessions all fall into that bucket, the genuinely-valid prior session gets evicted from the lookup window and the entire Codex block in the popover / TUI renders as `--`. The scan window is widened from 5 to 30 (covers a typical 1–2 day usage range); the first non-null result still early-returns, and the `primary.used_percent` / `secondary.used_percent` parsing path is unchanged. The new Codex CLI 0.134.0 schema fields (`limit_id`, `limit_name`, `credits`, `plan_type`, `rate_limit_reached_type`) are deliberately not parsed — UI doesn't use them. Three new tests cover the "5 null then 6th valid", "all 30 null returns None", and "pick most recent valid" scenarios.

**Dashed Claude Code project names now decode correctly**: `history_loader._project_from_path` previously replaced every `-` in the encoded directory name with `/`, so `Desktop-claude-tutorial-video` would become `/Desktop/claude/tutorial/video` — a non-existent path. `resolve_project_name`'s fallback then took the last segment, mis-labeling the project as `"video"` instead of `"claude-tutorial-video"`. The decoder now tries the all-slash candidate first; on miss, it DFS-walks the segments, joining adjacent ones with `-` and preferring whichever variant actually exists on disk. When nothing matches, the encoded name (minus the leading `-`) is kept as-is so dashes round-trip (`plain-project` stays `plain-project`). For most users, the JSONL `cwd` field already overrides the project name, so this primarily fixes older entries that lack `cwd`.

**TUI language detection routed through `usage_lang.detect_lang`**: `tui.py` had its own detector that only returned `zh-TW` or `en` (treating simplified Chinese, Japanese, and Korean as English), and ignored `USAGE_LANG` / `TT_LANG` / `LANG` entirely. The menubar already used `usage_lang.detect_lang()`, so the same machine could show Japanese in the menubar and English in the TUI. The TUI now shares the same detector — all five languages render consistently.

**LRU cap on history / codex loader caches**: `_file_cache` and `_jsonl_cache` were unbounded module-level dicts. As `~/.claude/projects/` and `~/.codex/sessions/` accumulated more jsonl files over time, the menubar's resident memory grew without bound — parsed `UsageEntry` lists never got released. Both caches are now `OrderedDict`s with a 512-entry ceiling: cache hits `move_to_end` to mark MRU, inserts on a full cache `popitem(last=False)` the oldest. The mtime/size invalidation logic and codex_loader's `entry.model` rebind on cache hit are unchanged.

**Significantly expanded test coverage**: previously undercovered modules `setup_app` / `ui/tables` / `usage_cli` now have direct unit tests; the suite grew from 234 to 363 tests. No production code was changed.

title.zh-TW: 解決 Codex 區塊破圖與專案名稱解析錯誤
title.en: Fixed blank Codex panels and mangled project names

body.zh-TW: 你的 Codex 面板現在不會因為幾次中斷的對話就整塊變成空白了。以前如果你連續跑了幾個極短的對話（例如剛跑就按 Ctrl-C 取消），系統往前找資料時會被這幾個「空包彈」洗版，找不到額度資料就直接罷工顯示「--」；現在它會往回翻找更久的紀錄，確實把你該有的配額顯示出來。此外，以前專案資料夾名稱裡如果有連字號（例如 `my-awesome-project`），系統會自作聰明把它切碎，讓你認不出自己的專案；現在它學會了正確拼湊連字號，你的專案終於能用原本的名字見人了。就像你去超商查點數，以前店員只要看到你最近五筆消費都是 0 元，就會直接告訴你查不到資料，而且還會把你的名字念錯；現在他會往前多翻幾頁找出你真正的餘額，而且終於把你的名字念對了。
body.en: Your Codex panel will no longer mysteriously go blank just because you had a few brief sessions. Previously, if you ran several quick commands that were interrupted (like pressing Ctrl-C), the system would only check the last 5 logs. Since those short "dud" sessions lacked quota data, the system gave up and displayed "--"; it now looks much further back to find your actual rate limits and model info. Additionally, if your project folder name contained hyphens (like `my-awesome-project`), the system used to mangle it into an unrecognizable path; it now correctly decodes hyphens, displaying your project's true name. It's like checking your loyalty points: the cashier used to see five $0 transactions and claim you had no account while mispronouncing your name; now they flip back further to find your actual point balance and finally call you by the right name.

title.zh-TW: 終端介面語系同步，背景常駐不再狂吃記憶體
title.en: Terminal language syncs automatically, and background memory bloat is fixed

body.zh-TW: 現在你用終端機打開用量表時，它的語言會跟選單列完全一致。以前終端機有自己的小脾氣，只認得繁體中文跟英文，如果你用日文或韓文介面，它還是會硬塞英文給你；現在它們終於說同一種語言了。同時，我們解決了常駐程式越跑越吃資源的問題。以前系統會把你看過的所有歷史紀錄都永遠塞在記憶體裡，對話越多，它佔用的記憶體就越肥；現在我們幫它裝了個「只能記 512 筆」的腦袋，塞滿了就會自動忘掉最舊的。就像圖書館以前把所有借回來的書都堆在櫃檯不還回去，導致櫃檯被塞爆；現在櫃檯規定只能放 512 本書，有新的書進來，就會把最舊的書乖乖放回書架上。
body.en: When you open your usage tables in the terminal, the language now perfectly matches your menu bar. Previously, the terminal interface was a bit stubborn—it only understood Traditional Chinese and English, and would force English on you even if you had Japanese or Korean selected in the main app. Now, both interfaces speak the exact same language. At the same time, we've fixed a major resource leak in the background app. The system used to hoard every single chat history log you ever loaded in its memory forever, causing its memory footprint to endlessly balloon over time. We've now installed a strict "512-item limit" to its brain, automatically clearing out the oldest data when full. It's like a library front desk that used to pile up every returned book forever until the desk collapsed under the weight; now, the desk holds a strict limit of 512 books, automatically shelving the oldest ones when a new one arrives.

items.original:
**TUI language detection routed through `usage_lang.detect_lang`**: `tui.py` had its own detector that only returned `zh-TW` or `en` (treating simplified Chinese, Japanese, and Korean as English), and ignored `USAGE_LANG` / `TT_LANG` / `LANG` entirely. The menubar already used `usage_lang.detect_lang()`, so the same machine could show Japanese in the menubar and English in the TUI. The TUI now shares the same detector — all five languages render consistently.
**LRU cap on history / codex loader caches**: `_file_cache` and `_jsonl_cache` were unbounded module-level dicts. As `~/.claude/projects/` and `~/.codex/sessions/` accumulated more jsonl files over time, the menubar's resident memory grew without bound — parsed `UsageEntry` lists never got released. Both caches are now `OrderedDict`s with a 512-entry ceiling: cache hits `move_to_end` to mark MRU, inserts on a full cache `popitem(last=False)` the oldest. The mtime/size invalidation logic and codex_loader's `entry.model` rebind on cache hit are unchanged.

entries: **Stale update badge clears immediately after upgrading**: `usage_statusline.py:_read_update_hint` only compared the cached `current_version` against `latest_version` without consulting the actual running version. The menubar app's 24h dismiss cooldown returned early before refreshing the cache, so a user already on v0.11.13 would keep seeing "v0.11.5 available" until cooldown expired. `_check_update_in_background` now refreshes `current_version` in the cache on startup (even during cooldown), and if the running version has caught up to `latest_version`, both fields are leveled so the badge disappears immediately.

**Codex usage bucketed by token_count deltas (@ericweichun, #11)**: `analyzer/reporter.py`'s fast path previously parsed Codex `.jsonl` files to extract a cumulative snapshot keyed by session-start timestamp, which diverged from the popover (which uses `codex_loader.load_entries` with per-event delta logic). The reporter now shares the same loader, so today/week/month reports match the popover exactly. Added a reporter-layer test exercising a cross-day cumulative Codex session to verify only the current-day delta is counted.

**All-Time reports tied to the project range selector (@ericweichun, #15)**: v0.11.6's analyze-bridge refactor left out the All-Time period, so clicking All-Time showed 720h cached data instead of true all-time. The bridge now maps `projectRange === "all"` through `_analysis_period_from_project_range("all") → "all"`, and project history loads with `hours_back=0` for true all-time data. All 9 panels gained a `projectRange === "all"` branch; `project_range_all` i18n keys added across all 5 locales.

**Manual refresh button queues while busy (@ericweichun, #12)**: previously, pressing refresh while one was already running silently dropped the second request. Now a single follow-up is queued, and the completion `finally` block runs in order: `codex_model = result.get("codex_model", "unknown")`, web language injection, clear the busy flag, then drain one queued refresh.

**Setup guidance made agent-neutral (@ericweichun, #16)**: the setup button previously gated on `~/.claude/` existence, hiding it from Codex-only users. The check is now "any status-line target available" (`~/.claude/` or `~/.codex/config.toml`); the existing `setup_hook.setup()` flow already auto-detects which agent to configure. Both README variants (zh-TW + en) reworded to agent-neutral phrasing; ja/ko `hook_not_installed` translations filled in.

title.zh-TW: 更新完不再被假標籤糾纏，重整與安裝按鈕更聽話
title.en: Fake update badges vanish instantly, and buttons behave much better

body.zh-TW: 現在你只要一升級完新版本，畫面底下的「可更新」標籤就會瞬間消失。以前系統因為有 24 小時的冷卻期，就算你已經是最新版了，它還是會看著舊的筆記本死抓著標籤不放，讓你以為自己沒升級成功。另外，當你急著多按幾次「手動重整」按鈕時，系統不會再把你第二次的點擊直接丟進水裡，而是會乖乖排隊等上一輪忙完再幫你重整一次。對於只裝 Codex 的使用者，安裝連線程式的按鈕現在也會正確出現了，不再因為你沒裝 Claude 就把你當邊緣人。就像你剛繳完卡費，網銀首頁的「催繳通知」立刻就消失，不用等到隔天；而你連按兩次電梯按鈕，電梯也確實知道你在急，不會假裝沒看見。
body.en: The moment you upgrade to a new version, the "update available" badge at the bottom of your screen will vanish instantly. Previously, due to a 24-hour cooldown period, the system would stubbornly look at its outdated notes and keep flashing the badge even when you were already fully up-to-date, tricking you into thinking the update failed. Also, if you impatiently click the manual refresh button while the system is already busy updating, it will now politely queue your request to run right after, instead of just tossing your click into the void. And for Codex-only users, the button to install the connection program now correctly shows up, rather than ignoring you just because you don't use Claude. It's like paying off your credit card and seeing the "payment overdue" warning disappear instantly instead of the next morning; and when you double-press the elevator button, the elevator acknowledges your urgency instead of ignoring the second press.

title.zh-TW: 分析報告不再鬧雙包，全時期與當日數據精準對齊
title.en: Analysis reports sync perfectly, aligning all-time data and daily usage across the board

body.zh-TW: 你的分析報告和面板上的數字現在完全統一了。以前系統看 Codex 的對話紀錄時，分析報告跟主面板是各算各的，有時會發生你明明同一天講的話，報告卻把它算到前一天去；現在它們共用同一套計算規則（把累積數字切成每一筆小變動去算），今天講的絕對只算在今天。而且，當你把專案時間範圍切換成「全期（All Time）」時，報告現在真的會把所有紀錄都挖出來算給你聽，不會像以前一樣只偷懶抓最近 30 天的資料敷衍你。這就像公司裡的財務部跟業務部以前各拿一本帳本，月底對帳永遠對不上，現在他們終於看同一個系統裡的同一份資料，不管你要查今天還是查公司創立以來的總帳，數字都分毫不差。
body.en: The numbers in your analysis reports and your main dashboard are now in perfect harmony. Previously, when interpreting Codex session history, the report and the dashboard used two separate methods to calculate tokens. This sometimes meant usage from a conversation you had today was wrongly attributed to yesterday; they now share the exact same logic (bucketed by exact event deltas), guaranteeing today's usage stays perfectly confined to today. Furthermore, when you switch the project range to "All Time," the report actually digs up your entire history to give you the true total, instead of lazily grabbing just the last 30 days and calling it a day. It's like the sales and finance departments finally ditching their separate spreadsheets to use the same central accounting system—whether you're checking today's revenue or the all-time gross since the company was founded, the numbers finally match up flawlessly.

entries: **Removed Codex model footer from popover**: the "· model: gpt-5.5" suffix added in v0.11.6 (`menubar.py:868-870`) misled users into thinking the model was being used *right now*, when in fact it reflects the model of the most recent Codex session with rate_limits data — possibly hours old. Without a timestamp context, this information is noise that can't be acted on. TUI model displays (`ui/tables.py:818,857`) are kept since they live inside different contexts (active session block / idle panel). The `model_label` i18n key and `CodexRateLimits.model` field are preserved; only the popover footer concatenation is removed.

title.zh-TW: 拿掉底部容易誤導的模型標示，還給畫面清爽
title.en: Removed misleading model labels from the footer to keep things clean

body.zh-TW: 你打開面板時，最下面不再顯示 Codex 模型的名稱了。這是因為之前顯示的其實是「上次有留紀錄時」用的模型，可能是好幾個小時前的事了，卻很容易讓人誤以為「現在這一秒」正在用它。因為這個資訊看了也只會讓人混淆，我們決定把它拿掉，讓畫面更乾淨。就像你去銀行抽號碼牌，如果螢幕上一直掛著「上一位客人的辦理項目」，你只會覺得一頭霧水；現在直接把它擦掉，清清爽爽。
body.en: When you open the popover panel, you'll no longer see the Codex model name at the very bottom. This is because the label was actually showing the model used during "your last recorded session"—which could have been hours ago—leading people to mistakenly believe it was actively being used right that second. Since this out-of-context information was more confusing than helpful, we simply removed it to clean up the interface. It's like waiting at the bank: if the digital display kept showing the transaction type of the customer from three hours ago, you'd just be confused; now the board is wiped clean to avoid misunderstandings.

items.original: **Removed Codex model footer from popover**: the "· model: gpt-5.5" suffix added in v0.11.6 (`menubar.py:868-870`) misled users into thinking the model was being used *right now*, when in fact it reflects the model of the most recent Codex session with rate_limits data — possibly hours old. Without a timestamp context, this information is noise that can't be acted on. TUI model displays (`ui/tables.py:818,857`) are kept since they live inside different contexts (active session block / idle panel). The `model_label` i18n key and `CodexRateLimits.model` field are preserved; only the popover footer concatenation is removed.

entries: **Hook self-heal: broken installs fix themselves, silently**: every startup now runs `setup_hook.self_heal()`, which silently repairs three clearly-safe scenarios: (1) first-run (`is_setup()==False` and no `statusLine` key in settings) → invokes `setup()`; (2) hook script version is out of date (`needs_update()==True`) → `update_hook()`; (3) settings points to a missing hook file with state `us-direct`/`us-forwarder` → re-runs `_copy_hook_script()` + `_copy_forwarder_script()`. When state is `external`/`legacy-tt`, all three skip (no silent override of third-party tools). Each action appends to `settings["usage"]["selfHealLog"]` (FIFO, 20 entries). Failures are swallowed; stderr is printed only when `USAGE_DEBUG=1`.

**Coexistence prompt consolidated**: when an external statusLine tool is detected, usage shows a single NSAlert with two buttons ("Enable Coexistence Mode" / "Keep Current Setup"). Either button sets `settings["usage"]["forwarderModePromptDismissed"]=True` and the prompt never appears again. Replaces the previous three-button repair dialog in `main.py:health_check()`; the "remind me later (24h cooldown)" path is removed. Users who previously chose "Do Not Ask Again" on the old dialog will be re-prompted once (one click resolves it).

**`--doctor` hidden CLI flag**: `python3 main.py --doctor` prints a plain-text diagnostic report (English-only for easier GitHub issue searches) covering hook state, version, script file status, status file mtime, external hook detection (recognizes `ccusage` / `lord-kali` keywords), forwarder prompt ack state, last 5 self-heal log entries, and Codex sessions scan count. Hidden from `--help` via `argparse.SUPPRESS` so it doesn't distract typical users. New `doctor.py` renderer module.

**Weekly burn warning no longer over-reacts to short bursts**: previously the weekly warning extrapolated from the most recent 10-minute sample window, so a single large prompt could trigger a scary "8 hours until empty" warning that vanished once the user took a break. The weekly warning now uses a 30-minute sample window with a 30-minute minimum span, requiring sustained high usage for at least half an hour before triggering. Session warnings keep the 10-minute window (session resets are frequent, can't be too strict). `burn_rate.ROLLING_WINDOW_SECONDS` was raised from 15 to 60 minutes so the longer window has enough history.

**Burn warning text now says "at current pace"**: all 5 languages' burn warning strings now explicitly include "按目前速度 / At current pace / 現在のペース / 현재 속도", making it clear that this is a momentary extrapolation rather than a stable prediction.

title.zh-TW: 系統學會自己修復連線，與其他工具和平共存不擾人
title.en: The system repairs its own connections and peacefully coexists with other tools

body.zh-TW: 以前如果 Claude 的連線程式（hook，負責把用量傳出來的小程式）不小心被刪掉或過期了，你得自己打指令重裝。現在每次開啟 usage，它都會默默幫你檢查；如果是單純的檔案不見或版本太舊，它會一秒內自己修好，你完全不會發現。如果你同時有安裝別人的連線工具，它也不會偷偷蓋掉別人的設定，只會跳一次簡單的視窗問你要不要「共存」，點過一次以後就永遠不會再煩你。就像家裡的水管工，以前管子稍微鬆了還要你打電話叫他來，現在他會定期巡邏默默鎖緊；如果看到有別的師傅在施工，他也會禮貌地問一聲要不要配合，而且只問一次。
body.en: Previously, if Claude's connection hook (the small script that relays your usage data) was accidentally deleted or became outdated, you had to manually run setup commands to fix it. Now, every time usage starts, it quietly checks its own health; if it spots a missing file or an old version, it instantly repairs itself without you ever noticing. If you happen to be running third-party connection tools alongside it, it won't aggressively overwrite their settings. Instead, it asks exactly once if you want to enable "coexistence" mode, and then never bothers you about it again. It's like a plumber who used to require a phone call every time a pipe came loose, but now does silent maintenance rounds; and if he sees another contractor working, he politely asks how to coordinate—and only asks once.

items.original:
**Hook self-heal: broken installs fix themselves, silently**: every startup now runs `setup_hook.self_heal()`, which silently repairs three clearly-safe scenarios: (1) first-run (`is_setup()==False` and no `statusLine` key in settings) → invokes `setup()`; (2) hook script version is out of date (`needs_update()==True`) → `update_hook()`; (3) settings points to a missing hook file with state `us-direct`/`us-forwarder` → re-runs `_copy_hook_script()` + `_copy_forwarder_script()`. When state is `external`/`legacy-tt`, all three skip (no silent override of third-party tools). Each action appends to `settings["usage"]["selfHealLog"]` (FIFO, 20 entries). Failures are swallowed; stderr is printed only when `USAGE_DEBUG=1`.
**Coexistence prompt consolidated**: when an external statusLine tool is detected, usage shows a single NSAlert with two buttons ("Enable Coexistence Mode" / "Keep Current Setup"). Either button sets `settings["usage"]["forwarderModePromptDismissed"]=True` and the prompt never appears again. Replaces the previous three-button repair dialog in `main.py:health_check()`; the "remind me later (24h cooldown)" path is removed. Users who previously chose "Do Not Ask Again" on the old dialog will be re-prompted once (one click resolves it).

title.zh-TW: 隱藏診斷指令上線，額度用盡警告不再一驚一乍
title.en: Hidden doctor command available, and burn warnings stop crying wolf

body.zh-TW: 現在如果遇到疑難雜症，你可以用一個隱藏的 `--doctor` 指令來印出英文診斷報告，方便上網抓藥。更棒的是，介面上的「每週額度燃燒警告」變穩重了。以前只要你連續十分鐘狂問問題，系統就會嚇得推算出「剩下 8 小時就會把整週額度用光」的誇張數字；現在它會觀察整整半小時，確定你真的是持續高用量才會發出警告，而且五種語言的警告文字都會明確加上「按目前速度」的免責聲明。就像車子的油表預測，以前你只是踩了一腳油門超車，它就警告你油只夠開三公里；現在它會看你這半小時的平均車速再來估計，還會老實告訴你「這是用你現在猛踩油門的速度算的」。
body.en: If you ever run into tricky issues, you can now use a hidden `--doctor` command to print a full English diagnostic report, making it much easier to search for solutions online. Even better, the weekly burn-rate warning on your dashboard has stopped being so dramatic. Previously, if you blasted through prompts for just 10 minutes, the system would panic and project that you'd drain your entire week's quota in 8 hours. It now observes you for a full 30 minutes to confirm you're actually sustaining a high burn rate before sounding the alarm, and the warning text across all five languages now explicitly adds an "at current pace" disclaimer. It's like your car's range estimator: instead of flashing an empty tank warning just because you floored the gas pedal to pass a truck, it now watches your average speed over the last half hour, honestly noting "this is based on how heavy your foot is right now."

items.original:
**`--doctor` hidden CLI flag**: `python3 main.py --doctor` prints a plain-text diagnostic report (English-only for easier GitHub issue searches) covering hook state, version, script file status, status file mtime, external hook detection (recognizes `ccusage` / `lord-kali` keywords), forwarder prompt ack state, last 5 self-heal log entries, and Codex sessions scan count. Hidden from `--help` via `argparse.SUPPRESS` so it doesn't distract typical users. New `doctor.py` renderer module.
**Weekly burn warning no longer over-reacts to short bursts**: previously the weekly warning extrapolated from the most recent 10-minute sample window, so a single large prompt could trigger a scary "8 hours until empty" warning that vanished once the user took a break. The weekly warning now uses a 30-minute sample window with a 30-minute minimum span, requiring sustained high usage for at least half an hour before triggering. Session warnings keep the 10-minute window (session resets are frequent, can't be too strict). `burn_rate.ROLLING_WINDOW_SECONDS` was raised from 15 to 60 minutes so the longer window has enough history.
**Burn warning text now says "at current pace"**: all 5 languages' burn warning strings now explicitly include "按目前速度 / At current pace / 現在のペース / 현재 속도", making it clear that this is a momentary extrapolation rather than a stable prediction.

entries: **"Launch at login" toggle now takes effect immediately, no reboot needed**: `login_item.enable()` / `disable()` now invoke `launchctl bootstrap gui/<uid> <plist>` / `launchctl bootout gui/<uid>/<label>` in addition to writing/removing `~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.lollapalooza.usage.plist`, so launchd learns about the change right away. Previously only the plist file was touched, so the toggle did nothing until the next reboot, and disabling left a KeepAlive orphan process behind. `launchctl` "already bootstrapped" (exit 17) and "not bootstrapped" (exit 113) are treated as success; other failures log a warning without affecting the plist operation (signatures stay `() -> None`).

title.zh-TW: 「開機自動啟動」開關立刻生效，不用等到下次重開機
title.en: The "Launch at login" toggle now takes effect instantly without a reboot

body.zh-TW: 以前你在選單裡點了「開機自動啟動」的開關，系統只會默默記在筆記本裡，你得等到下一次重開機，電腦才會真的照做；要是你把它關掉，背景還會留下一支不會停的舊程式。現在只要你一點開關，系統就會馬上拍拍電腦的肩膀跟它說「現在就開始」或「馬上停下來」，不用再等重開機了。就像你跟大樓管理員說明天開始不要送報紙了，以前他只會寫在明天的交接本上，今天還是照送；現在他會立刻用對講機跟派報生說停送。
body.en: When you toggled "Launch at login" from the menu, the system previously just jotted it down in a config file and waited for your next reboot to actually do anything about it; and turning it off left a zombie background process running. Now, the moment you flip the switch, the system instantly taps macOS on the shoulder to say "start doing this now" or "stop right now", with zero reboots required. It's like telling the building manager to cancel your newspaper delivery: they used to just write it in tomorrow's log while still delivering today's paper, but now they immediately radio the delivery person to stop.

items.original: **"Launch at login" toggle now takes effect immediately, no reboot needed**: `login_item.enable()` / `disable()` now invoke `launchctl bootstrap gui/<uid> <plist>` / `launchctl bootout gui/<uid>/<label>` in addition to writing/removing `~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.lollapalooza.usage.plist`, so launchd learns about the change right away. Previously only the plist file was touched, so the toggle did nothing until the next reboot, and disabling left a KeepAlive orphan process behind. `launchctl` "already bootstrapped" (exit 17) and "not bootstrapped" (exit 113) are treated as success; other failures log a warning without affecting the plist operation (signatures stay `() -> None`).

entries: **TUI session table no longer crashes on `cost_usd=None`**: widened `ui/tables.py:_fmt_cost` to `float | None` so entries written without a cost (a known path on the Codex side) now render as `--`, matching the popover-side behavior in `panels/web_panel.py`. Previously the `>=` comparison raised `TypeError` and broke the whole table.

**Update check now handles pre-release versions**: `update_checker._parse_version` now strips pre-release / build suffixes via regex, so `0.11.0-beta.1` / `0.11.0+build.5` no longer return `None` and no longer make `compare_versions` raise. Beta testers receive update prompts correctly. No new package dependencies were added.

**Pricing falls back to a stale cache when offline**: the fallback order in `pricing.py` is now fresh cache → network fetch → stale cache → hardcoded fallback. Previously a >7-day-old cache combined with no network dropped straight to the hardcoded prices, skewing cost estimates; the real (if stale) historical cache is now preferred.

title.zh-TW: 離線估價更準確，測試版更新不再漏接，終端介面不崩潰
title.en: Accurate offline estimates, fixed beta updates, and crash-free terminal UI

body.zh-TW: 現在帶筆電出門沒網路時，系統估算花費會直接拿你上週剛抓過的價目表來算，不會再傻傻退回最古老的出廠價，讓成本估算大失真。如果你是愛用測試版的勇者，系統現在也看得懂「beta」這類後綴版號，有新版會正確跳出更新提示，不再報錯裝死。另外，用終端機查看對話紀錄時，就算有些紀錄沒有標示花費金額，畫面現在只會顯示「--」，不會再導致整個表格直接崩潰壞掉。就像出國沒網路時，你會拿出幾天前存的舊匯率表來換算，而不是硬用十年前的書本價格；而且就算清單裡某幾項商品沒貼標籤，結帳機台也不會整台當機了。
body.en: When you're working offline without internet, the system now smartly estimates your costs using the real price list you fetched last week, instead of wildly falling back to ancient factory-default prices and skewing your budget. If you're an early adopter running beta versions, the update checker now understands version numbers ending in "beta", delivering update prompts correctly instead of throwing an error and playing dead. Also, when viewing your session history in the terminal, if a specific entry happens to lack cost data, it now gracefully displays "--" rather than crashing the entire table. It's like traveling abroad without data: you use the exchange rate you saved a few days ago instead of blindly relying on a ten-year-old guidebook; and if a couple of items on your grocery receipt are missing price tags, the whole cash register doesn't explode.

**Update check now handles pre-release versions**: `update_checker._parse_version` now strips pre-release / build suffixes via regex, so `0.11.0-beta.1` / `0.11.0+build.5` no longer return `None` and no longer make `compare_versions` raise. Beta testers receive update prompts correctly. No new package dependencies were added.
**TUI session table no longer crashes on `cost_usd=None`**: widened `ui/tables.py:_fmt_cost` to `float | None` so entries written without a cost (a known path on the Codex side) now render as `--`, matching the popover-side behavior in `panels/web_panel.py`. Previously the `>=` comparison raised `TypeError` and broke the whole table.

entries: **git worktree entries collapse into the main project**: running Claude Code or Codex inside a worktree (a duplicate working tree of the same repo) no longer splits `usage` and `usage-fix-bug` into two separate rows in the HTML report and TUI ranking. They are now grouped under the main worktree's directory name. A new `project_resolver.py` module (stdlib only, 3-second timeout, falls back to the previous basename behavior when git is unavailable) is shared by `history_loader.py` and `codex_loader.py`. Seeing historical totals merge on first upgrade is the intended behavior.

title.zh-TW: 同一個專案的平行副本，用量不再被拆得七零八落
title.en: Parallel working copies of the same project no longer fracture your usage stats

body.zh-TW: 當你用工作樹（worktree，讓同一個專案多開幾份平行副本的 Git 功能）來修 bug 或開發新功能時，系統終於懂得把帳算在一起了。以前它會把你主資料夾跟副本資料夾的用量拆成兩個獨立專案，導致你的用量排行榜看起來很亂；現在它會自動把這些副本的用量，全部算在主專案頭上。升級後如果你看到某些專案的數字突然變大、名次合體，這是正常的。就像你拿了幾張附卡給家人刷，以前帳單會分開好幾份寄來讓你眼花，現在全部彙整到主卡帳單裡，一眼就能看出總共花了多少。
body.en: When you use worktrees (a Git feature that lets you check out multiple parallel copies of the same project) to fix bugs or build features, the system finally knows how to consolidate the bill. Previously, it would split the usage from your main folder and your copies into separate projects, cluttering your leaderboards; it now intelligently groups all that usage under the main project's name. If you notice some project totals suddenly merging and growing upon upgrading, this is completely expected. It's like handing out supplementary credit cards to your family: instead of receiving a confusing pile of separate statements, everything is now cleanly rolled up into one master bill, making it immediately clear how much was spent in total.

items.original: **git worktree entries collapse into the main project**: running Claude Code or Codex inside a worktree (a duplicate working tree of the same repo) no longer splits `usage` and `usage-fix-bug` into two separate rows in the HTML report and TUI ranking. They are now grouped under the main worktree's directory name. A new `project_resolver.py` module (stdlib only, 3-second timeout, falls back to the previous basename behavior when git is unavailable) is shared by `history_loader.py` and `codex_loader.py`. Seeing historical totals merge on first upgrade is the intended behavior.

entries: **Pricing cache moved under `~/.usage/`**: the LiteLLM pricing cache now lives at `~/.usage/pricing_cache.json` instead of `~/.claude/pricing_cache.json`, following the principle that usage-owned state belongs in its own directory. The legacy path stays as a read-only fallback for seamless migration. Thanks @ericweichun.

**Explicit `usage report --help` and unknown-option handling**: previously the CLI silently ignored unknown report options and `--help` still triggered agent detection. Now `--help` returns the help text immediately and unknown options error out cleanly. Thanks @ericweichun.

title.zh-TW: 設定檔搬家不留痕跡，終端機指令不再裝聾作啞
title.en: Configs move homes seamlessly, and terminal commands stop playing deaf

body.zh-TW: 你平常不用管的計費快取（cache，暫存資料的地方）現在搬到了專屬的資料夾裡，而且系統會自己讀舊檔案當備用，你完全不用重設。另外，在終端機打 `usage report` 指令時，如果打錯字，以前系統會假裝沒看到直接跑預設畫面，現在它會明確報錯教你怎麼打；查說明文件（`--help`）的速度也變快了。就像你把家裡的工具箱換了個抽屜放，要用的時候自動拿到手；而平常那個問錯問題就沉默的助理，現在終於會主動說「不好意思，你指的是這個嗎？」了。
body.en: The billing cache (where temporary data is stored) has smoothly moved to its own dedicated folder. The system will still read your old file as a backup, so you don't have to lift a finger to migrate. Also, when you make a typo running the `usage report` command in the terminal, instead of silently ignoring you and running the default report, the system now stops and tells you what went wrong. Looking up the help manual (`--help`) is also noticeably faster. It's like moving your toolbox to a new drawer and having your tools automatically show up in your hand when needed; and that assistant who used to stare blankly when asked the wrong question finally speaks up to say, "Sorry, did you mean this instead?"

items.original:
**Pricing cache moved under `~/.usage/`**: the LiteLLM pricing cache now lives at `~/.usage/pricing_cache.json` instead of `~/.claude/pricing_cache.json`, following the principle that usage-owned state belongs in its own directory. The legacy path stays as a read-only fallback for seamless migration. Thanks @ericweichun.
**Explicit `usage report --help` and unknown-option handling**: previously the CLI silently ignored unknown report options and `--help` still triggered agent detection. Now `--help` returns the help text immediately and unknown options error out cleanly. Thanks @ericweichun.

entries: **Codex model shown in the popover footer**: the footer now displays the currently detected Codex model; when no model data is available it falls back to `unknown` instead of leaving the state blank.

**Analysis report period follows the Project Usage range**: the Report button now switches output periods with the current project range, mapping 1d to today, 7d to week, and 30d to month. No new UI was added; it uses the existing range control.
**Japanese / Korean Codex model labels completed**: added the missing ja / ko `model_label` translations so footer model information no longer renders blank in Japanese and Korean UIs.

**Codex today / week / month reports now use tail scanning**: users with many sessions no longer wait for a full history scan when opening reports. Today reports drop from roughly 7 seconds to the 0.03-second range, with week / month benefiting from the same path.

title.zh-TW: 底部清楚標示 Codex 模型，日韓介面也不會一片空白
title.en: The popover footer clearly displays the Codex model, and Japanese/Korean UIs are no longer blank

body.zh-TW: 你現在可以直接在介面底部看到目前正在使用的 Codex 模型。以前如果剛好沒有模型資料，畫面會空一塊讓你以為壞掉了，現在它會老實印出「unknown」。同時，日文與韓文介面的模型標籤也補齊了，切換語系一樣看得到。就像去餐廳點無菜單料理，以前主廚不說話你會以為沒菜了，現在菜單底部會確實寫上今日食材或是「主廚特製」，而且各國語言的菜單都印得清清楚楚。
body.en: You can now see exactly which Codex model is currently active right at the bottom of the interface. Previously, if no model data was available, the space was left completely blank, making you wonder if the app broke; it now honestly prints "unknown". Additionally, the missing Japanese and Korean model labels have been filled in, so you get the same clear info regardless of language. Like a mysterious chef's tasting menu—instead of leaving the dish name blank and making you guess if the kitchen closed, the menu now explicitly says "Chef's Secret" or prints the actual ingredients, fully translated for every guest.

items.original:
**Codex model shown in the popover footer**: the footer now displays the currently detected Codex model; when no model data is available it falls back to `unknown` instead of leaving the state blank.
**Japanese / Korean Codex model labels completed**: added the missing ja / ko `model_label` translations so footer model information no longer renders blank in Japanese and Korean UIs.

title.zh-TW: 分析報告時間範圍跟著專案走，累積再多對話也秒開
title.en: Analysis reports sync with your project range and open instantly regardless of history size

body.zh-TW: 你現在按出分析報告時，它的時間區間會自動對齊你正在看的專案範圍（Project Usage），切換 1d 就看今天、7d 就看本週，不用另外找按鈕設定。對於重度使用者來說，現在按出今日報告的時間從 7 秒大幅縮短到只要 0.03 秒。因為系統學會了「從尾巴往前掃描」，不再傻傻從盤古開天闢地第一筆對話開始讀。就像去圖書館查昨天的報紙，以前館員會從十年前的舊報紙一路翻到今天，現在他直接從最新的一疊拿給你，而且你說要找體育版，他拿出來的就直接是體育版。
body.en: When you generate an analysis report, its time period now automatically matches the project range (Project Usage) you're currently viewing—selecting 1d shows today, 7d shows this week, without needing a separate toggle. For heavy users, generating today's report has plummeted from a sluggish 7 seconds down to lightning-fast 0.03 seconds. The system now smartly scans backwards from the newest entries instead of mindlessly reading your entire history from the dawn of time. Like asking a librarian for yesterday's newspaper—instead of flipping through a decade of archives from page one, they now grab right from the top of the freshest pile, already opened to the section you requested.

items.original:
**Analysis report period follows the Project Usage range**: the Report button now switches output periods with the current project range, mapping 1d to today, 7d to week, and 30d to month. No new UI was added; it uses the existing range control.
**Codex today / week / month reports now use tail scanning**: users with many sessions no longer wait for a full history scan when opening reports. Today reports drop from roughly 7 seconds to the 0.03-second range, with week / month benefiting from the same path.
